Creative thinking.

I'm Akil Sutradhar Bappon, a digital marketer and graphic designer with a focus on clear communication, visual storytelling and consistent brand presentation.

My creative interests include social media post design, logos, brand identity, banners, posters, flyers and marketing graphics. I also have an interest in computer training and digital skills education.

Education: Bachelor of Social Science (BSS), Jagannathpur Govt. Degree College · Session 2023–2024.
